remarks: Welcome to this beautifully refreshed 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in the heart of downtown Stamford! This one-level unit offers an ideal blend of comfort and convenience, perfect for urban living. Enjoy abundant natural sunlight throughout, highlighting the open layout and freshly painted walls. The new wall-to-wall carpeting gives a warm, like-new feel, making it easy to settle in and make this space your own. Step outside onto your private deck - the perfect spot for morning coffee or relaxing after a long day. Inside, a full-size washing machine and dryer add to the convenience, along with an extra-large private storage room that provides ample space for all your needs. The unit also includes a deeded parking space in the gated parking area.  Building amenities include a club room, an exercise room, and a lovely private courtyard with grills - perfect for gatherings with friends or neighbors. And you'll love the location! Just steps away from Mill River Park and Carousel, you're also within walking distance of shopping, entertainment, and the Stamford Train Station for a quick commute. This condo offers the best of downtown Stamford living, blending comfort, convenience, and a vibrant community right outside your door!
